title: Miroir Ice Fishing Festival
text: Through the Miroir Glass book One of the quests gives a chest as a reward that contains 3 different scroll pieces or Winter Maiden coin. After collecting all 3 of the scrolls players can craft them into a book item that can be placed into the player house. Quests [Hungry Blizzard Cub] Feed meat to the polar bear cubs 3/3. [A Legendary Fisherman] Bring the npc 100 Iron Ingot. [The First Step of Ice Fishing] Craft a wrapped Miroir Ice Fishing Rod, bench to craft is next to this npc. Gives the scroll chest as a reward. If all 3 of the scrolls are collected it can be crafted into a book that can be placed in a house. Crafting requires 5 lumber. The fishing rod will expire and disappear after 9min after opening it. [Patience and a Bit of Luck] This quest can be repeated as many times as long as the player has the Miroir fishing rod to fish. Fish Smelts 10/10 from the ice holes. Drops are random. Right click the fishing icon to fish automatically.
html:
Through the Miroir Glass book

One of the quests gives a chest as a reward that contains 3 different scroll pieces or Winter Maiden coin. After collecting all 3 of the scrolls players can craft them into a book item that can be placed into the player house.


Quests

[Hungry Blizzard Cub]

Feed meat to the polar bear cubs 3/3.


[A Legendary Fisherman]

Bring the npc 100 Iron Ingot.


[The First Step of Ice Fishing]

Craft a wrapped Miroir Ice Fishing Rod, bench to craft is next to this npc.

Gives the scroll chest as a reward. If all 3 of the scrolls are collected it can be crafted into a book that can be placed in a house.


[Patience and a Bit of Luck]

This quest can be repeated as many times as long as the player has the Miroir fishing rod to fish.

Fish Smelts 10/10 from the ice holes. Drops are random. Right click the fishing icon to fish automatically.
